title: What did persistence contribute?
hook: A toy progress stock receives one unit of effort output per completed round.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to identify the fixed-gain assumption behind an effort illustration and separate it from personality evidence

misconception: A progress counter with fixed gains proves persistent effort guarantees achievement.
objective: Identify the fixed-gain assumption behind an effort illustration and separate it from personality evidence.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: No multiplicative human achievement formula; arbitrary progress units; same gain every round; more rounds exogenous; acquisition cost and fatigue absent. Four rounds finish at {A}; eight at {B}. Extra rounds add fixed units; nothing in this recurrence measures passion or grit.

claims.text: Does it hold up? Real progress can stall or reverse, and effort’s productivity is not fixed.
